description: Shell script for testing various core Git commands in a subdirectory, including setup, index updates, file listing, object inspection, diff, write-tree, checkout, read-tree, alias expansion, GIT_PREFIX, and repository ambiguity checks.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines to a file for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Reads a tree object and resets the working directory, expecting success.
